import re
p='tmp/gen.py'

old = '''    ids = rnd.sample(["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "i", "j",
                      "A_1", "zz-9", "x" * 32, "0", "conn_%d" % rnd.randint(0, 99)
                      for _ in range(200)], nconn) if nconn else []'''
new = '''    pool = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "i", "j",
            "A_1", "zz-9", "x" * 32, "0", "K9", "m-n_0"]
    pool += ["conn%d" % k for k in range(60)]
    ids = rnd.sample(pool, nconn) if nconn else []'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
